title: Be Messengers of God’s Light and Love | Sri Mrinalini Mata
formattedMarkdown:
# Be Messengers of God’s Light and Love

### Speaker • Sri Mrinalini Mata

### Introduction: The Purpose of the Soul

My dear ones, we gather today to reflect upon the sacred duty of the seeker. Paramahansa Yogananda often reminded us that we are not mere biological machines, but divine sparks of the Infinite. To live is not simply to exist; it is to manifest the light of God in every action, every thought, and every breath. As disciples of this path, our primary mission is to become clear channels for the Divine.

### The Necessity of Inner Transformation

We live in a world that is often clamorous, filled with the shadows of ego and desire. Yet, the light of God is ever-present. To be a messenger of that light, we must first clear the vessel of our own consciousness. This requires the practice of Kriya Yoga and deep, interiorized meditation. If the mirror of the heart is covered with the dust of worldly attachments, how can it reflect the sunlight of the Divine? We must practice the stillness that allows the soul to hear the whisper of God.

**Story • The Parable of the Tarnished Mirror**

Story: A master once told his disciples, "Your souls are like mirrors, meant to reflect the glory of the Infinite. But you have left them out in the storms of ego and material obsession for lifetimes. The dust has become thick. Many try to paint over the dust with intellectual study or outward displays of devotion. But the master says, 'Do not paint! Wash.' The washing is done through the constant application of meditation and right attitude. As you meditate, the dust clears, and suddenly, you are not just a person looking for God—you are the mirror reflecting God back to the world."

### Living the Teachings

It is easy to find peace in the silence of the shrine, but the true test is found in the marketplace. When we are faced with criticism, with trials, or with the selfishness of others, do we remain centered in the love of the Guru? To be a messenger of God’s love means that even when we are misunderstood, we respond with compassion. We do not retaliate. We realize that the person acting in ignorance is also a child of God, merely temporarily lost in the play of Maya.

### Service as a Spiritual Path

Service is not just an activity; it is a form of prayer. When we serve others without the expectation of reward, we are breaking the chains of the ego. Paramahansaji taught that 'The body is a temple of God.' When you serve another, you are serving that temple. Whether it is through the work of our organization, helping a neighbor, or simply holding a prayerful thought for a stranger, you are projecting the Divine vibration into the world.

**Story • The Master and the Humble Gardener**

Story: There was once a gardener who worked for a great saint. He never spoke of deep philosophy, nor did he claim to have visions. He simply tended the roses with such intense devotion that it seemed he was feeding the soul of the plant. One day, a visitor asked him how he reached such a state of peace. The gardener replied, 'I do not reach for peace. I simply surrender my work to the Beloved. When I water the roots, I imagine I am watering the consciousness of God within the earth. My work is not a chore; it is my conversation with the Divine.' This is the consciousness we must bring to our daily lives—the realization that every act, performed with love, is a sacred communion.

### Conclusion: A Call to Radiant Living

My dear ones, take this message with you into the silence of your hearts. You are the bearers of the flame. The world is waiting for your light. Do not let your practice be a stagnant pool; let it be a flowing river of service, kindness, and unceasing devotion to the Guru-given path. You have been given the highest teaching, the science of Kriya Yoga. Use it to transform your life, and in doing so, become a living testament to the love of God. God bless you all.
